# `aitbc dispute file`

File a new dispute against an agreement.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute file [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agreement-id` | integer | — | yes | Agreement the dispute is raised against. |
| `--respondent` | text | — | yes | Address of the party the dispute is filed against. |
| `--dispute-type` | text | — | yes | Dispute category, e.g. non_delivery or quality. |
| `--reason` | text | — | yes | Why the dispute is being filed. |
| `--evidence-hash` | text | — | yes | Hash of the supporting evidence. |
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute file --agreement-id <agreement_id> --respondent <respondent> --dispute-type <dispute_type> --reason <reason> --evidence-hash <evidence_hash>
```
